_comment: pocketmobs.json fences horror CREATURES. It cannot touch the mods that have no entity at
all and work by acting on the world or the chat - a message from nobody, a torch that goes
out, a house that burns down. Those were global, which is how the words 'Help me' appeared
in chat in redstone land, a creative redstone sandbox.
A listed effect runs ONLY in the listed dimensions. An effect listed here with an empty
array is off everywhere; an effect NOT listed here is never touched at all.
horror_messages  - the Horror Messages mod. Gated per level by a mixin on the single
private procedure both its timer and its command funnel through, so the
message is dropped only for the level it was headed to.
serversidehorror - Server-Side Horror. It has no gateable funnel: its effects are inlined
into its own mixins on the server, level and player ticks. Instead its
per-effect enable switches are held down unless a player is in one of
these dimensions. Side benefit: a horror base is no longer burned down
or stripped of torches while you are away in another pocket dimension.
Each real dimension needs listing separately, exactly as in pocketmobs.json, or the
ambience would stop at the edge of the horror overworld.
